mapper.sql: id, openid, phone, nickname, avatar, gender, balance, status, ban_until AS banUntil, deleted, last_login_time AS lastLoginTime, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_user WHERE openid = #{openid} AND (deleted = 0 OR deleted IS NULL)
SELECT FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{id} AND (deleted = 0 OR deleted IS NULL)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user(openid, nickname, avatar, status) VALUES (#{openid}, #{nickname}, #{avatar}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET ban_until = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND (deleted = 0 OR deleted IS NULL) AND status = 0 -- 不碰永久封禁 AND ban_until IS NOT NULL AND ban_until <= NOW()
UPDATE sys_user SET openid = NULL, phone = '', nickname = '', avatar = '', gender = 0, deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND (deleted = 0 OR deleted IS NULL)
UPDATE sys_user SET last_login_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND (deleted = 0 OR deleted IS NULL)
